## Verification

- [ ] Dart files are formatted.
- [ ] `flutter analyze` passes.
- [ ] `flutter test` passes.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior.
- [ ] Localized strings go through `AppLocalizations` and every ARB file was updated (or the change is English-template-only and marked as needing translation).
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated when relevant.
- [ ] No keys, credentials, personal data, task exports or local tooling files are included.
